christians-reading-classics.title: All Quiet on the Western Front, with Jason Barnhart
christians-reading-classics.description: A single sentence can hold an entire war: “All quiet on the Western Front.” That understatement is exactly why Erich Maria Remarque’s novel still haunts readers almost a century later, and why we wanted to slow down and read it carefully rather than treat it like a history lesson. Today we are joined by Jason Barnhart, a peace theologian and professor of historical theology, to talk through the transparency, humanity, and paradoxes that make  All Quiet on the Western Front a true classic of war literature.
